title: Sending feedback to another device is a developer option
steps: Launch a Debug build with -UseFakeData and open the Help menu
In Settings › Advanced › Developer options, turn on Send to another device via Tailscale
Open the Help menu and Settings › Advanced again
expected: Send Feedback to Another Device… is missing until the option is on, then shows in the Help menu and on the Advanced page. No wording names a particular device.
